description: This file implements a plugin for the WPEFramework that interfaces with Rust code. It manages loading Rust shared libraries, creating and destroying Rust plugin instances, and handling communication between C++ and Rust components, including message passing, connection management, and plugin initialization.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: Holds context information for a request, including channel ID and authentication token.

classes.name: PluginContext
classes.description: Represents a plugin instance context, including an ID and a callback function for sending data.

methods.name: find_rust_plugin
methods.description: Attempts to locate and load a Rust plugin shared library from a given filename or search paths.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, loads the Rust shared library, and sets up function pointers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up and unloads the Rust plugin.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specified channel.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a Rust plugin method with a JSON request and handles the response.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Handles a new client connection by notifying the Rust plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Handles client disconnection by notifying the Rust plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Creates a new JSON-RPC message or processes an inbound message.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the plugin object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the plugin object.
